question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **laudable**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Laudable**" means deserving praise and commendation. (प्रशंसा और प्रशंसा के पात्र)

 
 
• **For example**: *Her dedication to community service is truly laudable.*
 
 
 
• The sentence requires an adjective to describe the blank, and "**laudable**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• Grammatically, "laudable" is an adjective that modifies the noun it precedes.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Louder**" is a comparative adjective that means producing more sound than something else. (किसी अन्य चीज़ की तुलना में अधिक ध्वनि उत्पन्न करना)
 
• "**Labelled**" is a verb that means to assign a label or tag to something. (किसी चीज़ को लेबल या टैग निर्दिष्ट करना)
 
• "**Lower**" is a comparative adjective that means situated below or at a lower level. (नीचे या निचले स्तर पर स्थित)
